svg.title: B2.1-S1 Pass 5 — Master Geometry Technical Validation
svg.desc: Technical proof sheet measured from the accepted Pass 5 master SVG. It shows the source geometry, bounding box, symmetry axes, raster conclusions and measured normalized relationships.
svg.text: B2.1-S1 PASS 5 — MASTER GEOMETRY TECHNICAL VALIDATION
Measured from the accepted SVG source; legacy generative annotations are not used.
Measured bounding box: x=50…950, y=50…950 → U = 900 master units
SOURCE / TOPOLOGY
• 2 canonical closed fill paths; 4 exact rotations each
• 4-fold rotational symmetry by construction
• Outer + inner flow remain separate; white channel is retained
• No automatic geometry correction applied during validation
MEASURED PROPORTIONS
Overall extent U: 900 × 900 units
Outer cardinal radius: 450 = 0.500 U
Central aperture envelope: 360 × 360 = 0.400 U
Outer-flow maximum width: ≈53.3 = 0.059 U
Inner-flow maximum width: ≈50.7 = 0.056 U
Inter-flow channel: ≈23.5…75.0 = 0.026…0.083 U
Widths are sampled normal-distance estimates; tips intentionally tend to zero.
CONTINUITY CHECK
Major cubic joins are near-tangent (0…2.5° outer; 0…1.1° inner).
Intentional cusps remain at cardinal tips and axial construction junctions.
The central aperture uses point-junction closure; it is visually stable at master scale.
RASTER VALIDATION
64 / 32 / 24 px: two-level flow and aperture remain legible. 20 px: lower safety margin. 16 / 12 px: fragile channels and axial junctions.
Minimum reliable canonical-master size: 24 px. A controlled micro variant is recommended below 20 px; it is not constructed in this Unit.
